content.text: [Slack #cc-dev +0m 2026-03-10 14:00 EST] rocky (U0ABC123): Can you review the latest PR for the budget app? I made some changes to the Docker setup.

I'll review the PR right away. Let me pull up the changes and check the Docker configuration.

Looking at the PR, I can see:
1. Updated `Dockerfile` with multi-stage build
2. New `docker-compose.portainer.yml` for Portainer deployment
3. Fixed the nginx proxy configuration

The changes look solid. The multi-stage build will reduce the image size significantly.
[Slack #cc-dev +2m 2026-03-10 14:02 EST] rocky (U0ABC123): Great, can you also check if the health endpoint is working correctly?
✅ The health endpoint at `/api/health` is configured correctly in the nginx setup. It proxies to the backend container on port 5000 and returns a JSON status response.
